title: 'The Murders in the Rue Morgue,' by Edgar Allen Poe, Part Two (1/3)
titleZh: 愛倫坡〈莫爾格街兇殺案〉第二部分 (1/3)
summaryZh: 愛倫坡故事第二部分：敘述者結識杜賓，兩人從報上讀到莫爾格街的兇殺案。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — American Stories

sentences.text: was in Paris, in the summer of 1840, that I met Auguste Dupin.
sentences.zh: 是在 1840 年夏天的巴黎，我認識了奧古斯特‧杜賓。

sentences.text: Dupin was a strangely interesting young man with a busy, forceful mind.
sentences.zh: 杜賓是個奇特而有趣的年輕人，頭腦活躍又敏銳。

sentences.text: He seemed to look right through a person and uncover their deepest thoughts.
sentences.zh: 他好像能看穿一個人，把對方內心最深處的想法挖出來。

sentences.text: Sometimes, Dupin seemed to be not one, but two people.
sentences.zh: 有時候，杜賓感覺不像一個人，倒像是兩個人。

sentences.text: One who coldly put things together, and another who just as coldly took them apart.
sentences.zh: 一個冷靜地把線索拼湊起來，另一個同樣冷靜地把它們拆解開來。

sentences.text: One morning, in the heat of the summer, Dupin showed me once again his special mental power.
sentences.zh: 在一個酷熱夏日的早晨，杜賓再一次讓我見識到他特殊的心智能力。

sentences.text: We read in the newspaper about a terrible killing.
sentences.zh: 我們在報紙上讀到一起可怕的兇殺案。

sentences.text: An old woman and her daughter, living alone in an old house in the Rue Morgue, had been killed in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 一位老婦人和她的女兒獨自住在莫爾格街的一棟老房子裡，半夜遭到殺害。

sentences.text: The story in the paper went...
sentences.zh: 報紙上的報導是這樣寫的……

sentences.text: Paris, July 7th, 1840. Early this morning, cries of terror were heard in the western part of the city.
sentences.zh: 巴黎，1840 年 7 月 7 日。今天清晨，城市西邊傳出驚恐的尖叫聲。

sentences.text: They reportedly came from a house on the Rue Morgue, in which the only occupants were a Mrs. L'Espanier and her daughter Camille.
sentences.zh: 據報導，聲音來自莫爾格街的一棟房子，屋裡只住著 L'Espanier 夫人和她的女兒 Camille。

sentences.text: Several neighbors and a policeman ran to the house.
sentences.zh: 幾位鄰居和一名警察趕到那棟房子。

sentences.text: By the time they reached it, the cries had stopped.
sentences.zh: 等他們趕到時，尖叫聲已經停了。

sentences.text: As they entered, they heard two voices, apparently from above.
sentences.zh: 一進門，他們就聽見兩個說話的聲音，似乎是從樓上傳來的。
